about_the_game:
Discover the art of Hidden Cats in Spooky Village in a charming Coloring Book and Coloring Poster collection!
Both come as high-resolution PDF files, perfect for printing — or for creating beautiful digital paintings in your favorite software.

A wonderful gift for yourself, friends, or family. Relax, unleash your creativity, and share your colorful masterpieces!

🐾 Meow! It’s also a lovely way to support us and the Hidden Cats series.

Contents:

hcrio_coloringbook.pdf (A4 page size)

hcrio_poster_A0.pdf (A0 page size)

After downloading, get the PDF files in the game directory where it is installed

1 - Go to your library, find the game, and click with the second mouse button.

2 - Click on Properties, Local Files

3 - Click on Browse

This will open the game directory and you'll see the folder called "DLC_Coloring_Book" or something similar.
